description: Set the editable fields for a site by hand, or keep a chosen subset after a scan. `pages` is an array of { key, title?, url?, remove?, fields:[{ id, label, kind, bind?, auto? }] }; kinds are text, textarea, html, photos, file, files, list. A page passed with remove:true, or a field left out, stops being editable. scan_site discovers fields; this curates or defines them precisely.

pages.description: Page definitions, each with a key and a fields array (see description).

name: save_fields
title: Save fields
